items.source: Set the time required for concurrent handling to complete. This property should not be set when concurrent handling is in progress, i.e. when isAsyncStarted() is true.
items.translation: 设置并发处理所需的时间。当并发处理正在进行时，不应设置此属性，即当isAsyncStarted()为true时。

items.source: Whether the request is in async mode following a call to startAsync().
items.translation: 该请求在调用 `startAsync()` 后是否处于异步模式。

items.source: Whether the request is in async mode following a call to startAsync(). Returns "false" if asynchronous processing never started, has completed, or the request was dispatched for further processing.
items.translation: 是否在调用 `startAsync()` 后请求处于异步模式。如果异步处理从未开始、已完成，或请求已分派以进行进一步处理，则返回 "false"。

items.source: Add a handler to invoke when request processing completes.
items.translation: 添加一个处理器，在请求处理完成时调用。

items.source:
Add a handler to invoke when an error occurred while concurrent
handling of a request.
items.translation: 添加一个处理器，在并发处理请求时发生错误时被调用。

items.source: Add a handler to invoke when concurrent handling has timed out.
items.translation: 添加一个处理器，在并发处理超时时被调用。

items.source:
Dispatch the request to the container in order to resume processing after
concurrent execution in an application thread.
items.translation: 将请求分派到容器中，以便在应用程序线程中的并发执行后恢复处理。

items.source:
Mark the start of asynchronous request processing so that when the main
processing thread exits, the response remains open for further processing
in another thread.
items.translation: 标记异步请求处理的开始，以便当主处理线程退出时，响应仍保持打开状态以供其他线程进一步处理。

items.source: timeout - amount of time in milliseconds; null means no timeout, i.e. rely on the default timeout of the container.
items.translation: timeout - 以毫秒为单位的时间量；null 表示无超时，即依赖容器的默认超时时间。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if async processing has completed or is not supported
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果异步处理已完成或不支持

items.source: Extends NativeWebRequest with methods for asynchronous request processing.
items.translation: 扩展带有异步请求处理方法NativeWebRequest。

items.source: Set the time required for concurrent handling to complete.
items.translation: 设置并发处理所需的时间以完成。
